verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a hosted AI video-generation service like Veo, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, data-usage controls, or opt-out settings; the docs and community items cover generation quality, audio, access, pricing and moderation only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
